text:
amanda: Ok team — Acme pilot kickoff today. Need to align scope + eval harness before Wed sprint start. Main asks from the buyer: (1) golden prompt set for invoice extraction + Q&A, (2) clear scoring rubric, (3) timeline and any pricing tradeoffs, (4) security questionnaire blockers. Can we run through quick bullets?
chris: @amanda got it. Prioritize use cases: invoice extraction (high), conversational Q&A over docs (med). Do we have sample Prompts?/seed examples from Acme?
amanda: They sent 500 anonymized invoices and a small FAQ dump. Sharing link: https://redwood.example/acme-samples (read-only). Also constraints: <100ms median generation latency target for chat flows, batchable extraction ok if <300ms tail.
devon: Pricing note — for a short POC we can offer trial reserved capacity (1 GPU equivalent) + credits. If they want higher throughput we'll recommend Dedicated with monthly commit. For scoring: we should include cost-per-infer estimates in the deck.
maria: For eval harness: recommend 3 tiers of tests — smoke (syntactic), golden (business-critical), regression (historical). Anchor prompts + expected canonical answers. We should capture both exact-match and F1/span overlap for extraction tasks.
amanda: Good. What's a simple scoring rubric we can ship quickly?
chris: Draft rubric: 
```
- Extraction: span-F1 (0-1) weighted 0.6
- QA: top-1 accuracy (0-1) weighted 0.3
- Latency: penalty if p95 > SLO (0 or -0.1) weighted 0.1
Final score = 0.6*F1 + 0.3*Acc + 0.1*(1 - latency_penalty)
Thresholds: pass >= 0.75; warn 0.6-0.75; fail <0.6
```
chris: Also include a human-review fallback rate metric (allowed up to 10% for pilot).
ron_sales: Buyer also flagged security Qs: data residency (EU), KMS integration, audit logs. @devon can you confirm Private deployment option and timeline?
devon: Private deployment (VPC) can be delivered in ~6 weeks with enterprise support. For pilot we can do VPC-peering to hosted with strict retention and encryption in transit + KMS. Need SOC2 docs; security-team already has a pack.
amanda: Ok capture blockers: 1) EU KMS proof 2) NDA / data processing addendum 3) SSO/SAML for console access. Who owns each?
chris: I can own SSO setup and demo. @maria can you link the regression harness template?
maria: Linking template and recommended CI hooks: https://redwood.example/harness-templates/regression-ci. Quick config snippet for harness runner: 
```yaml
model: redwood/finetuned-invoice-v1
batch_size: 8
metrics:
  - name: span_f1
  - name: top1_accuracy
  - name: p95_latency_ms
regression_gate:
  threshold: 0.6
  alert: slack:#eng-oncall
```
maria: For inter-annotator agreement we recommend kappa >= 0.7 on golden set during label sanity check.
ron_sales: Timeline ask from customer: 2-week scoping + 2-week pilot + 1-week wrap. Can we commit?
devon: Yes for minimal scope (extraction golden set + 2 small QA flows). If they expand scope (more documents, multimodal), we need to rebaseline.
amanda: Action items: 
- chris: assemble prioritized seed prompts + scoring notebook by EOD tomorrow
- maria: publish harness template + CI hooks and example data by EOD
- devon: confirm pricing note and private deployment options in the proposal (incl lead times)
- ron_sales: push NDA + security questionnaire to legal and loop security-team
please add any quick blockers here.
chris: one blocker — we need sample entity taxonomy from Acme (invoice fields they care about). I pinged them.
amanda: noted. If we get taxonomy + sample mappings we can map span extraction labels to the scoring.
deploy-bot: calendar invite created: "Acme POC sync" Thu 10:00 AM (link: https://calendar.example/evt/1234)
amanda: thanks :thumbsup: I'll prep the customer-facing acceptance criteria doc and share a one-pager after our EOD sync.
ron_sales: I'll include a short pricing appendix showing tradeoffs (hosted vs dedicated vs private) and expected per-invoice cost estimates.
maria: One more — add regression gate that runs daily during pilot and posts summary to #pilot-metrics. Keeps us honest :eyes:
amanda: Perfect. Closing this thread; will reopen if blockers surface.
